name: Nate Bosshard
current_role: Co-founder & partner, Offline Ventures (VC firm); co-founder of Tonal
profile: Nate Bosshard is a consumer-brand builder who co-founded Tonal, the connected strength-training machine company valued around $2B, leading brand and marketing. Earlier he worked at Burton Snowboards, The North Face, GoPro and was a partner at Khosla Ventures. He now invests via Offline Ventures, which he started in 2020 with Dave and Brit Morin and James Higa.
interesting_fact: Offline Ventures, which he co-founded with Dave and Brit Morin and James Higa, closed a $100M debut fund with Apple reported as an anchor investor.
deep_cut_fact: He has been promoting an idea he calls 'algorithmic immunity' - reclaiming personal taste and identity from AI-driven feeds - and cites his time at Burton Snowboards as a model of brands that create a 'world' customers step into (Getting2Alpha podcast, June 2025).
notes: Tonal's founder/CEO was Aly Orady; Bosshard was a co-founder on the brand/marketing side. Best route is via Offline Ventures. Has done podcasts (Fitt Insider, Getting2Alpha) - receptive to brand/taste topics.

name: John Gedmark
profile: John Gedmark is an aerospace engineer (BS Purdue, MS Stanford, rocket propulsion) who co-founded Astranis in 2015 with Ryan McLinko to build small geostationary communications satellites using software-defined radios. Astranis (YC W16) launched its first commercial satellite, Arcturus, in 2023 for Alaska and has customers in the Philippines, Mexico, Thailand, Taiwan and the U.S. government.
interesting_fact: Astranis' first commercial MicroGEO satellite (for Pacific Dataport, serving Alaska) rode to orbit in April 2023 as part of a multi-satellite payload on the ViaSat-3 launch.
deep_cut_fact: Before Astranis he was Director of Rocket Flight Operations at the X Prize Foundation and co-founded and led the Commercial Spaceflight Federation, advocating for commercial crew policies.
notes: Highly relevant for a space/connectivity angle; Astranis HQ in San Francisco. X handle listed on an event speaker page, not independently verified on X.
